product.name: Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC)
product.description: A type of cement produced and sold in bulk or bag form, meeting American ASTM, British BS, European EN, and national SASO standards.

product.name: Sulphate Resisting Cement (SRC)
product.description: A cement type designed to resist sulphate attack, available in bulk or bag form, conforming to ASTM, BS, EN, and SASO standards.

product.description: A type of cement supplied in bags, used for finishing applications in construction.
